Pope Francis to undergo lung surgery for nodule

Pope Francis will undergo surgery in the coming days to remove a nodule found on his lung. The 71-year-old pontiff stated the nodule was identified at a very early stage. Separately, Pope Leo, identified in one report as Pope Leo, opposed a planned US military execution broadcast, stating the death penalty is inadmissible.
